requirement: A WordPress import stopped by a second factor, a captcha, a lockout, a firewall, a plugins folder WordPress cannot write, an update that left the old version, or a site that cannot serve the database names that reason instead of a wrong password or a generic failure

oracle.ref: PR #1465 (fix); fix evidence: PR 1465. Before the fix each gate read as a wrong password, unreachable or a generic install or call failure. Local WordPress 7.1 Docker stands (custom login slug, ModSecurity user-agent rule, second factor, captcha, lockout, FTP-only plugins folder, failed upgrade, Cloudflare challenge, persistent 500) were run during the change but not rerun after the last review fixes; this case pins the behaviour with the unit tests below.
oracle.invariant: Exit code 0 and `# fail 0`. Sign-in (wordpress-login): a correct password answered by a second-factor form is mfa_required; a lockout page is login_locked_out; a captcha error in the answer to the POST is captcha_required, while a wrong-password error, or a captcha widget that only loads, stays invalid_credential. Firewall (firewall, wordpress-login, wordpress-install, export-site-limits): a Cloudflare challenge or block page, a Sucuri, Wordfence, Imunify360 or ModSecurity page on the login page, the install probe, any installer step, the settings page or an engine call is blocked_by_firewall naming the product; WordPress's own 403 stays no_backend_access, also when the site is served through Cloudflare or Sucuri. Webroot (wordpress-login): a login page at a custom slug never makes the slug the webroot; the auth cookie Path decides when it names one, otherwise assets under the login path, other same-host assets, the login path's parent folders and the origin are tried in that order, and a guess whose wp-admin does not answer gives way to the next. Installer (wordpress-install): the Connection Information form is fs_credentials_required; a plugin still on the old version after the updater and the upload is upgrade_failed; a plugin the customer left deactivated is not switched on when the upload fails. Export (export-site-limits): every engine call carries the Tracy user agent; a site that answers 500 to large pages gets smaller pages until the dump is whole, and one that answers 500 to every page is site_resource_limit.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
